Both Indinavir and Spironolactone are known to interact with Abcc2, indicating a possible pathway through which Lovastatin may influence Abcc2 activity. The shared lowest common ancestors—Enzyme Inhibitor and Organic Heterocyclic Compound—suggest a common functional role in the biological process. The scores from the two paths are consistent, reinforcing the likelihood of a direct or indirect interaction between Lovastatin and Abcc2. The evidence supports a mechanistic link through the binding of Lovastatin to a compound that modulates Abcc2 activity, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be elucidated.
